# TC -【Fitness CRM】- [C-01-F][Admin Enrollment Form]

**Scope**: unit **D — Admin enrolment form** of `specs/025-enrollment-application-mgmt` (test plan §2): `/membership-applications/create` (管理画面入会), its confirm dialog (入会申請の内容を確認) and completion dialog (入会申請を登録しました), including the fixture applications that units B and C consume. Out of scope here (other units / other specs): list mechanics (unit A), detail review surfaces (unit B), approve / reject / cancel (unit C), mobile-app enrolment, FR-S001 visit screens (except the FR-058 hand-off), FR-S002 / FR-S003, A-01 member pages, F-01 billing, blacklist master screens.

## Test-data reference

**Run values** (record at the top of the run log; every expectation is computed from them, never from dates in this doc):

| Symbol                             | Meaning                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| ---------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| T                                  | Run date (JST).                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `{ts}`                             | `yyyyMMddHHmm` at run start. Run prefix = `TC-C01-{ts}` (e.g. `TC-C01-202610071530`).                                                                                                               |
| AGE(N)                             | 生年月日 = T minus N years (birthday today → age N).                                                                                                                                                |
| AGE(N)+1d                          | AGE(N) plus one day (turns N tomorrow → age N−1).                                                                                                                                                   |
| S                                  | Staff's 所属 store (and its brand), read from the app at run start.                                                                                                                                 |
| O                                  | A store outside Staff's scope (outside the Manager's 管轄 if possible), for TC-F-205.                                                                                                               |
| N0                                 | Baseline: rows found on the list when searching the run prefix, taken before a count-sensitive case.                                                                                                |
| LONG_STORE / LONG_PLAN / LONG_CAMP | Longest existing store / plan / accepting-campaign name in scope (read only; never edited).                                                                                                         |
| CP_PART / CP_FULL / CP_ZERO        | Existing accepting campaigns whose 入会金 discount is partial / ≥ list price / zero (read the fee card to classify).                                                                                |
| VALID_CODE                         | An existing **member-referral** (紹介) promotion code, read only. Round 2 (B1 partial): the list shows 紹介経由 only when the code is a member-referral code (`hasReferralPromotionCode`).          |
| BL_ID                              | 氏名 + 生年月日 of a pre-existing BL要注意 application (read from its detail, never acted on), used to provoke 一致あり.                                                                            |
| SAME_ID                            | The identity reused by TC-F-201 – TC-F-203.                                                                                                                                                         |
| S_LR                               | Ladyroom fixture store: the JOYFIT main fixture store of the 029 plan §8, in HQ scope, where CP_F and CP_ORD are usable (accepting, recruiting today, published).                                   |
| CP_F / PLAN-F                      | `QA-E02-AREA-CP-F`, 主契約 `QA-E02-AREA-PLAN-F` (area `QA-E02-AREA-F`, 女性のみ); created by the ladyroom run (029 plan §8; test plan §9 ladyroom exception). Never approved on (`E-PLN-001` lock). |
| CP_ORD                             | A pre-existing campaign usable at S_LR whose 主契約 has no 性別の条件 (`planGenderCondition: none`); read only, picked in the form only (DL-10).                                                    |
| S_ONLY                             | A store in scope where CP_F is the only usable campaign (DL-11).                                                                                                                                    |
| S_NONE / S_PLAIN                   | A store in scope with no usable campaign (as TC-F-096) / with usable campaigns, none of them gender-conditioned.                                                                                    |
| BASE-L                             | BASE-J with ブランド JOYFIT, 入会店舗 S_LR, 性別 and 適用キャンペーン as the case says; tag `XLDnnn` in 氏名（名） and the e-mail local part.                                                       |

### Data limitations (referenced in Notes)

| Id    | Limitation                                                                                                                         | Effect                                                                                                                    |
| ----- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| DL-1  | 一致あり needs an identity that matches a BL entry; BL masters are never edited.                                                   | TC-F-119, TC-F-198, part of TC-F-180 → `Block — data limitation` if BL_ID cannot produce a match.                         |
| DL-2  | A valid 紹介コード must already exist (promotion masters are never edited).                                                        | TC-F-105, TC-F-106, TC-F-107, TC-F-109, TC-F-199 → Block if none exists.                                                  |
| DL-3  | The backend may refuse a second / third application for the same identity.                                                         | TC-F-202, TC-F-203 → Block (and C's per-member limit sequence).                                                           |
| DL-4  | Store / plan / campaign / term / staff names are master data and never edited.                                                     | Long-name layout cases use the longest existing value plus response interception (layout only).                           |
| DL-5  | February usage start is unreachable while it is outside the selectable window.                                                     | TC-F-140 → Block when unreachable on the run date.                                                                        |
| DL-6  | Campaign discount types, a store without accepting campaigns and a plan without a 入会金 entry depend on existing masters.         | TC-F-129, TC-F-130, TC-F-146, TC-F-096, TC-F-141 → Block if the state does not exist.                                     |
| DL-7  | Staff's store has one brand.                                                                                                       | Fixtures of the other brand are created as HQ in a store within the Manager's 管轄.                                       |
| DL-8  | Max-digit amounts cannot be created with real masters.                                                                             | TC-F-179, TC-F-181 use price-estimate interception (layout only).                                                         |
| DL-9  | The shared backend moves under the run.                                                                                            | Counts are deltas against N0 or prefix searches, never absolute.                                                          |
| DL-10 | CP_ORD must already exist at S_LR (no other campaign is created or edited for the ladyroom slice).                                 | Without it S_LR shows the S_ONLY state: TC-F-235, TC-F-237, TC-F-238, TC-F-241, TC-F-243 step 1, TC-F-247 step 3 → Block. |
| DL-11 | S_ONLY exists only if the ladyroom setup makes CP_F the only usable campaign at a store in scope (beyond the 029 §8 fixture list). | TC-F-244, TC-F-245 step 2, TC-F-253 step 2 → `Block — data limitation`.                                                   |
| DL-12 | No QA campaign auto-grants a 女性のみ-area option, and the API exposes no auto-grant setting on campaigns.                         | TC-F-250 → `Block — data limitation`.                                                                                     |
| DL-13 | No QA campaign on `QA-E02-AREA-PLAN-M` / `QA-E02-AREA-PLAN-NOBODY` in the 029 §8 fixtures.                                         | TC-F-251 → `Block — data limitation`.                                                                                     |

## Priority definitions

| Priority | Meaning                                                                                                                                   |
| -------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| High     | Core / main-flow cases, fixture creation, access control, and UI issues immediately visible to the user (all long-text and layout cases). |
| Medium   | Validation cases.                                                                                                                         |
| Low      | Rare / edge cases.                                                                                                                        |

No record created (prefix X401 count 0). **Re-run 2026-10-08 (bug-fix):** real expiry simulated by clearing the SESSION cookie (access + refresh token) on a filled form (System): 申請を登録 → POST 401 → refresh impossible → `/login?redirect=…/membership-applications/create&variant=session-expired` with 「セッションの有効期限が切れました。再度ログインしてください。」; no completion dialog; nothing created (Y401 absent). The 2026-10-07 toast-only result came from intercepting 401 while the refresh token was still valid (refresh succeeded, retry hit the interception again) — not a real expiry.
